name: Tourism Finance Corporation of India Limited
summary: Tourism Finance Corporation of India Limited, a financing institution, provides financial assistance services in India. The company offers financial assistance by way of loans/investments for projects in tourism/hospitality, social infrastructure, residential real estate, manufacturing, educational institutions, hospitals, renewable energy, and logistics sectors. It also provides finance to non-banking and housing finance companies for secured onward lending. Tourism Finance Corporation of India Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in New Delhi, India.
